files.TASK.md: Fix this settings-report tool. Running node cli.cjs <path> prints one JSON object and a newline: {"enabled":<value>,"limit":<value>}. Settings files contain JSON objects; omitted enabled and limit use true and 10 respectively, while explicit false and zero survive. A missing file uses those defaults. Malformed JSON and all other read failures must fail: the CLI exits nonzero, writes the error message to stderr and no report to stdout. Preserve loadSettings(path, read) as an async API, with read defaulting to fs/promises.readFile, called once with path and "utf8". The API propagates the original non-missing read error and parse error. Keep both files usable without dependencies.

files.TASK.md: Fix the basket API used by demo.cjs. createBasket(initial = []) accepts rows {sku, price, quantity}; SKUs are unique strings, prices are nonnegative integer cents, quantities are positive integers. set(sku, price, quantity) replaces that SKU or appends a new one; remove(sku) removes it if present; reset(rows = []) replaces all rows. count is current total quantity and total is current price times quantity summed in cents. receipt() returns {items, count, total} as a fixed snapshot; input rows and returned receipt rows must not share mutable objects with the basket. Instances are independent, order follows insertion, replacing an existing SKU keeps its place. Preserve mutation method signatures; their return values are unspecified. Running node demo.cjs must print the receipt for two tea at 250 cents plus one cake at 400 cents.

files.TASK.md: Fix saveDraft in service.cjs while preserving the store adapter and public API. saveDraft(draft, {store, audit}) awaits store.write(draft) exactly once. On success it returns the exact store result and awaits audit({type:"saved", id:draft.id}); an audit failure propagates unchanged and must not generate a failed event. On write failure it awaits audit({type:"failed", id:draft.id}) exactly once then rejects with the original write error. A failed-event audit failure must also propagate unchanged; it takes precedence because this audit is required. Do not retry either operation. Both dependencies may return normally, throw synchronously, resolve, or reject. Keep createStore(writeFile) working: write(draft) calls writeFile(draft.id + ".json", JSON.stringify(draft), "utf8") and returns draft.id after the write completes.
